fork-notes.replace-spatie-ray: The top-level `replace` block for spatie/ray + spatie/laravel-ray is defense-in-depth. They were originally pulled in transitively via psalm/plugin-laravel -> orchestra/testbench -> orchestra/workbench -> spatie/laravel-ray -> spatie/ray, because orchestra/workbench declares spatie/laravel-ray as a regular `require` (not `require-dev`). Nothing in this project or any installed vendor package actually calls ray(). spatie/ray/src/helpers.php registers a shutdown handler at file-load time that invokes ray() -> class_exists(Spatie\LaravelRay\Ray::class); during `composer install --no-dev` inside a dev container that previously had dev deps, the shutdown handler fires AFTER the package is removed from disk but while composer's in-memory ClassLoader still holds the stale PSR-4 mapping, fatalling on the missing file. The `replace` block tells composer the root project provides these packages, so a future orchestra/workbench dep is satisfied without installing them. composer.lock has been hand-pruned (#613) to also drop the now-orphaned transitive deps: rector/rector, zbateson/{mail-mime-parser,mb-wrapper,stream-decorators}, pimple/pimple, symfony/polyfill-iconv. The original return-path (psalm/plugin-laravel pulling orchestra/workbench) is now gone — psalm was retired entirely in #647 (see `psalm-retired` below). The `replace` block is retained as cheap insurance in case the chain reappears via a different package; it costs nothing and trips loudly if it does. Safe to remove if you want to tidy; see brycehans/monica#613 for the original incident.
fork-notes.psalm-retired: Psalm was retired from this fork (closes #647) rather than re-enabled after the Laravel ladder cleared the original dep cascade. History: phase 2 (PHP 8.4 jump) removed vimeo/psalm and psalm/plugin-laravel from require-dev because psalm v5 crashed at startup on PHP 8.4 — psalm's own set_error_handler converted thecodingmachine/safe v2's implicit-nullable autoload deprecations into uncaught exceptions before analysis ran. Re-enablement at psalm ^6 + psalm/plugin-laravel ^3 became viable on the current Laravel 12 line (safe ^3, larastan v3, phpstan-safe-rule ^1.4 all in place). Retirement chosen over re-enablement because: (1) psalm.xml ran at errorLevel 7 (loosest tier) with no taint/security plugins, so incremental signal over PHPStan level 5 + larastan was small; (2) the 12 @psalm-* annotations in source were all suppressions of psalm-only complaints — none survived as PHPStan-meaningful information; (3) the fork has no public users, so a second analyzer's credibility-of-CI value is low against its maintenance cost. psalm.xml has been deleted; the @psalm-* annotations swept from source. PHPStan + larastan continue to cover the static-analysis surface.
fork-notes.rector-as-direct-dev-dep: rector/rector was added as a direct require-dev in phase 3 issue #668 to run the PHPUnit ANNOTATIONS_TO_ATTRIBUTES set across tests/ (converting 1397 doc-comment metadata annotations into PHP 8 attributes, eliminating PHPUnit 11's deprecation reports pre-D₃). Config lives at /rector.php. Note: the `replace-spatie-ray` fork-note above documents that rector/rector was previously hand-pruned from composer.lock as an orphaned transitive of the spatie/ray chain — that was a TRANSITIVE pruning. This entry is a DELIBERATE direct addition. Keep rector available going forward: D₃ (Laravel 11→12) and beyond will benefit from rector's framework migration sets. rector/rector 2.x is a single self-contained package with no transitive surface (verified via `composer require --dev rector/rector --dry-run`: lock operation is 1 install, 0 transitive deps).
